title: Browser alerts for staff and the record of direct database reads are listed as switched off, but both run live
what: The feature list marks two HQ server jobs as waiting for a secret key: gym alerts reaching staff browsers with the admin app closed, and the record of who read gym data with the database owner login. On 26 Nov HQ's public answers showed both keys are set: the browser-alert key is handed out, and the read record says it is on, not failing, with its key ending 14 Nov 2027. The database parts are live too. So both work for real gyms today while the map says they are held.
expected: A feature whose key is set and whose database part is live is listed as live.
how_often: every time someone reads the feature list
fix_line: Mark both features live in the feature list

title: The HQ and door-machine set-up notes still describe things as not done that are done
what: The HQ server's settings file still opens with 'not deployed', though HQ has been live at hq.mettleup.fit for weeks. The online plan buying file says its database change is not applied, though it is live. The door-machine service's checklist still lists 'apply the database change' as step one, though that change and all eight functions the service needs are already live; what really remains is the key, the address and the deploy. Anyone using these notes to decide what to do next is sent to finished work and misses how close the door service is.
expected: Each set-up note says what is really live and lists only the steps still left.
how_often: every time someone reads the set-up notes
fix_line: Update the first lines of the three set-up notes to match what is live
